name: race_second_hollow_orders
description: In a Tide Race a seat on the second team plays the second hollow with the same clicks (contract-m6.md §5): its build, signal and fork go out as its own hollow counts its cells and millimetres, so a click on board cell (32, 3) builds on its cell (6, 3), 26 tiles along, and nothing on the first hollow; a signal on its ground or its tower rings where it was given. The first hollow is its rival's here, and refuses its orders.

steps.msg: my seat plays the second hollow, the camera over it

steps.assert: node('BuildController').hover_cell == Vector2i(32, 3) and node('BuildController').can_build('arrow', Vector2i(32, 3)) and not node('BuildController').can_build('arrow', Vector2i(6, 3))
steps.msg: my grass is the second copy's; the first copy's is my rival's
the click built where it pointed

steps.assert: t.owner_seat == 2 and t.hollow == 1 and t.cell == Vector2i(6, 3) and absf(t.global_position.x - 32.5) < 0.001 and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)) == t
steps.msg: on my hollow's cell (6, 3), standing 26 tiles along

steps.assert: scene.sim.tower_at(1, 6, 3) != null and scene.sim.tower_at(0, 6, 3) == null and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(6, 3)) == null and count('towers') == 1 and Game.gold == 260
steps.msg: the simulation built it on the second hollow and nothing on the first; one Arrow Tower paid for
a signal on my ground rings where I clicked, on my hollow
a signal on my tower rings on the tower

steps.assert: scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 3)) != null and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(32, 3)).form == 'longbow_loft' and scene.sim.seat(2).forks == 1
steps.msg: and the fork takes on my tower

steps.assert: screen_has("That is your rival's hollow") and scene.tower_on(Vector2i(6, 3)) == null and node('BuildController').settled()
steps.msg: the first hollow is my rival's: a click there is refused
